name: Native silicon MOSFET DC transfer and output characterization,4.2–300 K (Zhang et al.2021)
plain_name: Measure transistor turn-on and leakage from room temperature to liquid helium
description: Measure transistor turn-on and leakage from room temperature to liquid helium. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

sources.citation: Zhang et al. (2021), Characterization and Modeling of Native MOSFETs Down to 4.2 K

requirements.rationale: Replicate the published device temperature span. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

An installed semiconductor source/measure analyzer and appropriate four-wire fixture are essential; a bare cryostat is insufficient. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

missing_information: The source used a wired Dewar, not a named cryogenic probe station. Substituting a station requires confirming installed analyzer, wiring/fixture, bias compliance and self-heating.
Probe-arm capacity alone does not prove source/drain/gate/body connections are installed; this remains part of analyzer/fixture review.
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed these exact sourced conditions on 2026-10-31. The application must still require the user's review/confirmation; all edits invalidate confirmation.
